headline: Argentina edge it, Belgium bully the USA, and a nil-nil shrug for Jack
text: Argentina (Nana) just about nicked a 3-2 thriller against Egypt (Sofia), while Belgium (Vicki) gave USA (Vicki) a 4-1 doing. Switzerland (Jack) and Colombia (Chris) shared a rather dreary 0-0. Biggest winner from the round: Nana. Biggest loser: Sofia, and Vicki’s USA had a right old pasting from Vicki’s Belgium. Overall, Max still leads the lot on 29 points. At the other end, Sofia is propping up the table on 10 points.
